notes.title: Ver.0.1.3_0 Update
notes.content:
■New Features
  ・Added new events about "fire", as well as related Buffs and Debuffs

  ・Added option to turn on/off fullscreen mode

■Improvements

  ・Gradually improve the tutorial

■Fixes
  ・Fixed a bug where production buffs did not work properly.

notes.title: Ver.0.1.1_0 Update
notes.content:
■New Features
  ・Added facility worker upper limit setting function
    Useful when you need to reduce the production efficiency of a facility or temporarily stop production
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171661/b56ed13924fda362318fc35dc0c8b5f4f7182498.png[/img]

  ・Newly implemented task extra rewards
    For some tasks, multiple rewards are defined, and the extra reward is randomly determined from them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171661/81ced9e2c05562cd1e9aeed46efe109ff564b7fd.png[/img]

■Adjustments
  ・Initial state storage capacity 100
  ・A certain amount of initial resources
  ・Some initial facility construction costs
